note: Meshy recipes. Prices read from docs.meshy.ai/en/api/pricing on 9 Oct 2026: preview meshy-7.1 20, meshy-t2 5; refine 2k 10. One job = one kind in one arm = preview + refine. The art direction is the plan's toy shop katamari: chunky, rounded, bright, saturated, soft bevels, painted, no baked light, no text, no logos, nothing photoreal. Styles: "toyshop" was the five prop pilot (stopped 9 Oct); "miniature" is the merge's handmade miniature (ASTRA-MERGE-OCT09.md 3.1), used from the benchmark on.

std.label: standard meshy-7.1, remeshed to 30k, decimated by dewfit

t2.label: smart topology meshy-t2 at the kind's own budget

t2r.label: smart topology re roll (a second try with a new prompt, kept apart in the ledger)

i2t.label: image to 3D from his ChatGPT sheet (cut by sheetcut.py), smart topology meshy-t2 at the kind’s own budget, painted from the picture
i2t.note: measured 10 Oct: 15 credits and 41 s for one textured smart topology task (ladybird.i2t)

cakestand.prompt: A celebration cake on a cake stand: a tall round pastel pink layer cake with a thick white icing top and one bright red cherry in the middle, resting on a wide round cream porcelain plate that sits on a short sturdy pedestal foot.
cakestand.texture: Pastel pink cake sides, glossy white icing, bright red cherry, warm cream porcelain plate and pedestal.

teapot.prompt: A round fat teapot glazed bright cornflower blue all over: a ball shaped body, a short curved spout, a loop handle, and a small domed blue lid with a gold knob.
teapot.texture: Bright cornflower blue glaze all over the pot, spout, handle and lid, a shiny gold knob, a thin white line round the rim.

ant.prompt: A cartoon picnic ant standing low and level on six legs, about three times longer than it is tall: three clearly separate round segments in a straight line, a small head with two bent antennae pointing forward, a smaller middle and a big oval rear, six legs spread out to the sides. One connected piece.
ant.texture: Glossy very dark brown body with warm brown highlights on the big rear segment.

sandwich.prompt: A whole square sandwich lying flat: two thick slices of soft white bread with golden crust, crisp green lettuce and red tomato slices peeking out between them.
sandwich.texture: Golden crust, soft pale bread, crisp green lettuce, juicy red tomato.

teacup.prompt: A small round porcelain teacup with one loop handle, cream white glaze with a thin gold rim, filled with warm brown tea.
teacup.texture: Cream white glazed porcelain, thin gold rim, warm brown tea.

crumb.prompt: A small torn piece of bread: an irregular rounded chunk with golden brown crust on one side and soft pale crumb with tiny airy holes on the torn side.
crumb.texture: Golden brown crust, soft cream crumb with tiny airy holes.

cookie.prompt: A round chocolate chip butter cookie, thick and golden with softly cracked edges and three dark chocolate chips on top.
cookie.texture: Warm golden biscuit, toasted edges, glossy dark chocolate chips.

cupcake.prompt: A cupcake: a golden brown baked cake in a pleated paper cup, topped with a tall swirl of pastel pink frosting and one red cherry.
cupcake.texture: Golden cake, pleated tan paper cup, soft pastel pink frosting, glossy red cherry.

ladybird.prompt: A cute ladybird beetle walking forward: a round glossy red shell with black spots, a small black head at the front, six short black legs.
ladybird.texture: Glossy red shell with round black spots, black head and legs.

chesspawn.prompt: A classic chess pawn: a round ball head on a short neck and a wide round stepped base, smooth turned wood.
chesspawn.texture: Dark walnut wood with a soft sheen and faint grain.

candle.prompt: A thick pillar candle in cream wax with a few soft drips at the top edge and a small golden flame on the wick.
candle.texture: Warm cream wax, soft drips, bright golden yellow flame.

basket.prompt: A wicker picnic basket with a hinged lid and a curved carrying handle arching over the top, woven straw.
basket.texture: Warm honey brown woven wicker, slightly darker lid rim and handle.

cookietin.prompt: A round cookie tin painted bright cornflower blue all over, with a silver lid and a plain cream band around its middle, a cosy old fashioned tin.
cookietin.texture: Bright cornflower blue paint all over the tin, a silver lid, a plain cream band with no words.

thermchair.prompt: A folding picnic chair standing open: a red fabric seat and backrest on a light grey metal crossed frame.
thermchair.texture: Bright tomato red canvas seat and back, light grey metal frame.

lmBookTower.prompt: A chunky leaning tower of nine thick hardcover books in bright colours, stacked so the whole tower visibly leans to one side, cream page edges showing on every book, a small golden knob on a short post on top.
lmBookTower.texture: Book covers in red, blue, orange, green, plum, yellow and teal, cream page edges, a golden knob.

lmGramophone.prompt: An antique gramophone: a dark walnut wooden cabinet with a black record on a turntable and a large flared golden brass horn rising up and out to one side.
lmGramophone.texture: Dark walnut wood, glossy black record with a red centre label, shining golden brass horn.

lmLongClock.prompt: A tall but broad and sturdy grandfather clock in dark walnut wood: a deep chunky case as wide as a wardrobe, a large round cream clock face with two black hands near the top, a brass pendulum behind a glass door, three golden finials on the crown.
lmLongClock.texture: Dark walnut wood, a cream clock face with simple black hour marks and two black hands, brass pendulum and finials.

kThimble.prompt: A small sewing thimble standing open end down: short and round, a little taller than it is wide, with a smooth rounded dome on top, the whole cap covered in a neat grid of tiny round dimples, and a plain polished gold band round the open rim.
kThimble.texture: Bright polished silver metal covered in tiny dimples, a shiny gold band at the rim. No brown, no wood, no straw.

butterfly.prompt: A small cartoon butterfly with its wings spread wide open to both sides: big bright sky blue wings with white spots and thin black edges, a slim dark body in the middle with two short antennae at the front.
butterfly.texture: Bright sky blue wings with white spots and thin black edges, a dark slim body.

kSpoon.prompt: A small polished silver teaspoon lying flat: an oval bowl and a slender handle with a little curl at the end.

kWatch.prompt: A round gold pocket watch lying flat, face up: a cream watch face with two black hands, a small crown and a ring at the top.
kWatch.texture: Shining gold case and ring, cream face with simple black hour marks and two black hands.

kSugarRose.prompt: A delicate pink sugar rose from a celebration cake: soft curled petals, a short green stem and one green leaf.
kSugarRose.texture: Pale pink and rose sugar petals, soft green stem and leaf.

kClover.prompt: A lucky four leaf clover standing on a short thick stem: four chunky round heart shaped green leaves.
kClover.texture: Fresh green leaves with lighter green markings.

picnictable.prompt: A wooden picnic table with bench seats attached on both long sides and sturdy legs, warm honey brown planks.
picnictable.texture: Warm honey brown wooden planks with a soft grain.

coolerbox.prompt: A picnic cooler box: a chunky rounded rectangular chest about one and a half times as wide as it is tall, a bright blue body with plain smooth sides and no windows or panels, a thick white lid on top and a sturdy dark blue carrying handle across the lid.
coolerbox.texture: Bright glossy blue body with plain sides, a white lid, a dark navy handle. No windows, no labels, no words.

berry.prompt: A single plump ripe raspberry made of many small round red beads, with a little green leafy cap on top.
berry.texture: Deep raspberry red beads with soft highlights, a small fresh green cap.

signpost.prompt: A simple wooden signpost: one straight round post with two flat blank arrow shaped boards fixed near the top, one pointing left and one pointing right, and a small round knob on top of the post.
signpost.texture: Dark brown wooden post and knob, light honey brown boards with no words or symbols.

lemonadejug.prompt: A chunky opaque pitcher painted bright lemon yellow, a little taller than it is wide, with a big loop handle sticking well out on one side, a wide pouring spout on the other, white lemon slices painted round its belly and pale yellow lemonade at the open top. Not glass, not a vase.
lemonadejug.texture: Bright lemon yellow glaze with white and yellow lemon slice pictures, pale yellow lemonade at the top.

bannerpole.prompt: A tall wooden flagpole standing straight up on a small round base, a gold ball on top, and one big bright red triangular pennant flag flying fully open out to one side near the top.
bannerpole.texture: Dark brown wooden pole and base, a bright red cloth flag, a shiny gold ball.

radio.prompt: A retro portable picnic radio: a rounded cherry red box with a cream speaker grille panel, two round gold knobs and a short silver antenna.
radio.texture: Cherry red casing, cream speaker grille, gold knobs, silver antenna, no words.

winebottle.prompt: A short squat round bottle of bright red fruit cordial, about one and a half times as tall as it is wide, with a round body, a short wide neck and a white swing top stopper, and a plain cream band round its middle.
winebottle.texture: Bright red cordial showing through the glass, a white stopper, a plain cream band with no writing.

chessrook.prompt: A short squat chess rook: a straight sided round tower about two thirds as wide as it is tall, its top rim cut into five big square battlement teeth like a sandcastle, a flat top inside them, and a plain wide round base. No crown, no points, no ball on top, no slim waist.
chessrook.texture: Polished warm walnut brown wood with a soft sheen, plain and smooth.

sugarbowl.prompt: A round cream porcelain sugar bowl with a lid and a small gold knob on the lid.
sugarbowl.texture: Cream white glazed porcelain, a thin gold trim, a gold knob.

plateK.prompt: A round china plate in classic blue and white lying flat: white glaze with a wide bold cornflower blue rim band around the outer third and a simple blue flower in the middle.
plateK.texture: White glaze, a wide bold cornflower blue rim band, a simple blue flower in the centre.

candystick.prompt: A thick straight stick of old fashioned rock candy standing upright with a rounded top, painted with bold diagonal red and white stripes that wind all the way around it like a barber pole.
candystick.texture: Bold alternating diagonal stripes of bright red and pure white winding around the whole stick, glossy sugar.

juicebox.prompt: A small orange juice box with a white bendy straw sticking out of the top.
juicebox.texture: Bright orange carton, a white straw, no words or pictures.

apple.prompt: A shiny red apple with a short brown stem and one small green leaf.
apple.texture: Glossy red apple with a few lighter speckles, brown stem, green leaf.

pie.prompt: A round berry pie with a golden crimped crust edge and dark purple berries showing through a lattice top.
pie.texture: Golden baked crust, dark purple berry filling.

cerealbox.prompt: A tall thin breakfast cereal box standing upright, its front about three times wider than its side, solid golden yellow cardboard with a plain red band across the top and one big simple red cereal bowl drawn on the front.
cerealbox.texture: Solid golden yellow cardboard, a plain red band across the top, one big simple red bowl shape on the front. Absolutely no letters, no words, no writing, no logos anywhere.

melon.prompt: A whole round watermelon with dark green stripes.
melon.texture: Dark green and light green striped rind.

crumbwall.prompt: A small wall section built from rectangular shortbread biscuit bricks laid in neat rows, a little taller than it is wide and half as deep as it is wide, flat on top with a few white sugar sprinkles.
crumbwall.texture: Golden shortbread bricks with lightly toasted edges and paler lines between them, white sugar sprinkles on top.

thermos.prompt: A chunky vacuum flask standing upright: a round teal body about three times as tall as it is wide with a broad silver band at its base, and a silver cup lid on top as wide as the body, with a small silver ring handle on the cup. Not a bottle, no cork.
thermos.texture: Bright glossy teal body, shiny silver cup lid and base band.

banana.prompt: A single ripe yellow banana, gently curved, with a small brown tip at each end.
banana.texture: Bright yellow peel with a few small brown freckles, brown tips.

jamjar.prompt: A small round jam jar full of red raspberry jam with a gold metal lid and a plain cream label.
jamjar.texture: Deep red jam through clear glass, gold lid, plain cream label with no words.

fork.prompt: A small picnic fork lying flat: four short silver tines and a chunky bright cobalt blue plastic handle.
fork.texture: Shiny silver tines, a glossy bright cobalt blue handle.

cracker.prompt: A thin flat square cracker biscuit about one tenth as thick as it is wide, with finely scalloped edges and a neat even grid of small pin holes across the top, like a saltine. Nothing like cheese, no big holes.
cracker.texture: Pale golden tan baked biscuit with toasted light brown edges and a neat grid of small dark pin holes.

strawberry.prompt: A classic ripe strawberry lying on its side: a plump cone shaped heart about one and a half times longer than it is wide, tapering to a rounded point, bright red evenly dotted with small yellow seeds, with a small flat star of green leaves at the wide end. Not round, not a tomato.
strawberry.texture: Bright glossy red evenly dotted with small yellow seeds, a fresh green star of leaves at the wide end.

napkin.prompt: A neatly folded cloth napkin in a soft square fold, cream white with a thin stitched edge.
napkin.texture: Soft cream white cotton with a faint weave and a thin stitched border.

eggboil.prompt: A whole white boiled egg, smooth and oval, standing slightly tilted.

saltshaker.prompt: A small round glass salt shaker with white salt inside and a silver dome cap with tiny holes.
saltshaker.texture: White salt through clear glass, a shiny silver cap.

lmCarousel.prompt: A music box carousel toy, round and about as wide as it is tall: a wide red tent roof with a cream peak and a gold ball on top, held up by a ring of eight thick cream poles on a low round gold platform, with a gold centre pole and four chunky carousel horses in pink and blue.
lmCarousel.texture: Glossy tomato red roof with a cream peak, cream poles, a bright yellow gold platform, centre pole and top ball, carousel horses in bright pink and cornflower blue.

lmJackBox.prompt: A big jack in the box toy with the jack popped out: a chunky red cube box with yellow bands and blue panels, its lid flung wide open, and a big grinning clown head with a pointed green hat and a white ruffled collar rising high out of the box on a thick coiled silver spring. The clown head is the tallest part. A gold crank on one side.
lmJackBox.texture: Tomato red box, sunny yellow bands, blue panels and lid, silver spring, peach clown face with dot eyes and a red smile, white ruffled collar, green hat with a yellow pompom, gold crank.

lmToyTrain.prompt: A wind up toy train set on its own round play mat, about three times as wide as it is tall: a thick light green mat ringed by a loop of bright blue toy track, and across it a chunky green steam engine with no face, chimney at the front, black cab at the back, pulling a red wagon and a blue wagon with yellow roofs.
lmToyTrain.texture: Emerald green engine with a plain front and no face, black cab and wheels, yellow chimney band, red and blue wagons, sunny yellow roofs, light grass green mat, bright blue track.

lmBlockFort.prompt: A toy fort of big plain painted building blocks, nearly twice as tall as it is wide: four wide flat slabs stacked in alternating red and blue, each smaller than the one below, a wide sunny yellow slab, four green pillars capped with coloured cubes, one big thick red flag flying fully open on top, and a dark door.
lmBlockFort.texture: Glossy tomato red and blue blocks, a sunny yellow slab, green pillars, cubes in red, blue, yellow and green, a bright red flag, a dark brown door, every block plain solid colour.

lmRocketStand.prompt: A stout retro toy rocket standing on a wide round grey launch pad with four thick grey posts holding it up, the whole thing about twice as tall as the pad is wide: a fat cream body with two wide red bands, a big red nose cone, four chunky red fins and one round blue porthole.
lmRocketStand.texture: Glossy plain cream body with two wide tomato red bands, a red nose cone and fins, a blue porthole, a light grey launch pad and posts.

dollhouse.prompt: A painted toy dollhouse, closed on every side, a little taller than it is wide: a two storey pale blush cream house about twice as wide as it is deep, a big steep rose pink pyramid roof, a chocolate brown front door in the middle, four big square warm yellow windows, two up and two down, and a tall grey chimney.
dollhouse.texture: Pale blush cream walls, a glossy rose pink roof, warm yellow windows, a chocolate brown door, a light grey chimney.

boardgame.prompt: A flat closed board game box lying flat, about five times as wide as it is tall: deep blue sides and a flat lid painted with a big bold checkerboard of red and cream squares, with two chunky pawns and one big die resting on the lid. No peaked lid, no writing.
boardgame.texture: Deep blue box sides, a lid painted as a red and cream checkerboard, one yellow pawn, one green pawn, a white die with black dots.

shoebox.prompt: A cardboard shoebox made into a toy house: a plain long shoebox with its lid propped up on top as a slanted roof, a big door and two windows cut into its long side with bold crayon outlines, and a little paper flag on the roof. It must look like a box first, not a cottage.
shoebox.texture: Plain cream cardboard with a pink lid, bold red and blue crayon outlines round the door and windows, dark openings, no labels or writing.

booktower.prompt: A tall solid stack of five very thick hardcover books lying flat, about one and a half times as tall as it is wide, each book a little smaller than the one below and turned slightly askew, with thick cream page edges, covers from the bottom up in red, blue, green, plum and golden yellow.
booktower.texture: Glossy book covers from the bottom up in tomato red, blue, green, plum and golden yellow, plain covers and spines with no titles, thick cream page edges.

bookwall.prompt: One solid chunky wall block, a little taller than it is wide and about two thirds as deep as it is wide, shaped as three thick storybooks standing upright, pressed together side by side with no gaps, in red, blue and green with cream page edges on the front, and a fourth plum storybook lying flat across their tops.
bookwall.texture: Glossy covers in tomato red, blue and green, a plum book lying on top, plain covers and spines with no titles, thick cream page edges.

train.prompt: A chunky tin toy steam engine with no face: a fat emerald green boiler with a plain round dark smokebox door and one round brass headlamp above it, a fat black chimney at the front, a boxy tomato red cab at the back and four chunky black wheels. Nothing painted on the front but the headlamp.
train.texture: Glossy emerald green boiler, a plain dark smokebox door, a shining brass headlamp, a black chimney and wheels, a tomato red cab. No face, no eyes, no mouth.

toycar.prompt: A chunky wind up toy car in bold sunny yellow, boxy with soft rounded corners, one and a half times as long as it is wide: a flat hood at the front with two big round white headlamps, a small rounded cabin with blue windows set back, four fat black wheels and a big red wind up key sticking out of the back. A generic toy, not a real car model.
toycar.texture: Glossy sunny yellow body, pale blue windows, white headlamps, black wheels, a bright red wind up key.

kBear.prompt: A honey gold teddy bear sitting upright, one and a half times as tall as it is wide, with a round tummy, a round head two thirds as wide on top, two round ears and short stubby arms and legs. It has one black button eye and a round blue patch sewn over the other eye. A big chunky bright blue bow at its neck.
kBear.texture: Soft honey gold fur, a cream muzzle, one shiny black button eye, a round bright blue patch sewn over the other eye, a big bright blue ribbon bow.

kTinRocket.prompt: A classic retro tin toy rocket standing upright on its fins, about twice as tall as it is wide across the fins. A fat round silver body that tapers gently toward the top, a chunky pointed tomato red nose cone, three big thick red fins flaring out at the base, and one round bright blue porthole window.
kTinRocket.texture: Plain shining silver painted tin body, glossy tomato red nose cone and fins, one bright blue porthole with a silver rim.

kMusicBox.prompt: An open music box: a small rectangular box painted bright pink with gold trim, its lid propped wide open with a round mirror inside the lid, and a cream ballerina about half as tall as the box twirling on a small gold pedestal in the middle. A gold wind up key on one side.
kMusicBox.texture: Glossy bright pink box with gold trim, a silver mirror in the lid, a cream ballerina in a pink tutu, a gold pedestal and key.

kTop.prompt: A classic painted wooden spinning top balancing on its point: a fat round body widest in the middle that tapers down to a sharp point at the bottom and rounds over at the top, a short stick handle on top, painted in bold blue and orange spiral stripes. No flat disc, no saucer, no brim.
kTop.texture: Glossy bold blue and orange spiral stripes, a gold handle.

kMarbleKing.prompt: A big glossy glass marble: a perfect sphere of deep royal purple glass with a bright swirl of orange and white twisting inside it, wearing a big shining gold crown with red jewels on top, the crown about a third as tall as the marble.
kMarbleKing.texture: Glossy royal purple glass with a bright orange and white swirl inside, a shining gold crown with red jewels.

dominoK.prompt: A single thick domino tile standing upright on its short end, twice as tall as it is wide, glossy jet black all over, with big round white dots on both broad faces, three in the top half and five in the bottom half, and a white line across the middle. Black, not white.
dominoK.texture: Glossy jet black tile with big bright white dots on both faces and a white centre line.

duck.prompt: A classic yellow rubber duck bath toy, about as tall as it is long, a big round body with a round head two thirds as wide sitting forward on top, a short flat orange beak pointing straight ahead and a little upturned tail at the back.
duck.texture: Glossy sunny yellow rubber all over, a bright orange beak, two small black dot eyes.

marble.prompt: A single round glass toy marble, a perfect smooth ball of bright sky blue glass with one bold wide white swirl inside it.
marble.texture: Glossy bright sky blue glass with one bold wide white swirl band twisting around it.

crayon.prompt: A fat wax crayon lying on its side: a chunky round stick about four times as long as it is thick, wrapped in a paper label band with a bold zigzag stripe, with a blunt rounded cone tip in the same royal blue as the body at one end and a flat end at the other. Not a pencil: no wood, no dark point.
crayon.texture: Royal blue wax body and tip, a paper wrapper band with a bold navy zigzag stripe, nothing written on it.

drum.prompt: A toy drum: a squat round drum about one and a half times as wide as it is tall, with tomato red sides and a smooth cream drumhead on top. A bold sunny yellow zigzag cord runs round the red sides between two yellow hoops. Two short chunky drumsticks with round tips lie crossed on the drumhead.
drum.texture: Glossy tomato red drum sides, a bold sunny yellow zigzag cord and yellow hoops, a smooth cream drumhead, sunny yellow drumsticks with red tips.

kite.prompt: A diamond shaped paper kite lying flat on the floor face up: a big flat diamond sail about as wide as it is long, bright orange with a bold blue cross from tip to tip, and a short thick ribbon tail with two bows trailing on the floor beside it.
kite.texture: Bright orange sail with a bold blue cross, a cream tail with one red bow and one blue bow.

teddy.prompt: A classic honey gold teddy bear sitting with its legs stuck straight out in front: a plump round tummy, a round head about two thirds as wide as the body, two round ears, stubby arms at its sides. A big bright red ribbon bow is tied at its neck. It has a cream muzzle, a small dark nose and simple dot eyes.
teddy.texture: Warm honey gold plush all over, a cream muzzle and cream paw pads, a big glossy tomato red bow, small black dot eyes and nose.

tricycle.prompt: A child's toy tricycle, a little longer than it is tall: one big front wheel under tall chunky handlebars and two smaller back wheels under a chunky sunny yellow seat. All three wheels are solid tomato red discs with thick black tyres and no spokes. A thick curved deep red tube frame joins them.
tricycle.texture: Glossy tomato red wheel discs, a deep red frame and handlebar post, thick black tyres and handlebar grips, a sunny yellow seat.

robot.prompt: A classic light steel blue wind up tin robot standing upright: a boxy body a little taller than it is wide with a plain smooth chest, a smaller square head on top with two round yellow dot eyes, blocky arms angled slightly out from its sides, two short blocky legs. A big red wind up key sticks out of its back.
robot.texture: Glossy light steel blue tin body and arms, a paler silvery blue head, darker slate blue legs, round sunny yellow dot eyes, a bright tomato red wind up key.

traintrack.prompt: A short straight section of toy railway track lying flat, about twice as long as it is wide and very low: two thick chunky bright blue rails run its full length, resting on three wide chunky sunny yellow sleepers spaced evenly under them with open gaps between.
traintrack.texture: Glossy bright blue rails, glossy sunny yellow sleepers, each part one smooth solid colour.

jenga.prompt: A short crisscross stack of five long chunky toy building blocks, about as tall as it is wide: one block per layer, each three times as long as it is wide, laid crosswise on the one below to make a plus shape seen from above. Blocks alternate sunny yellow and bright blue, the top one turned slightly askew.
jenga.texture: Glossy painted blocks alternating sunny yellow and bright blue from bottom to top, each block one smooth solid colour.

bouncy.prompt: A rubber bouncy ball: one perfectly round glossy ball, hot pink all over, with one wide bold deep plum stripe running diagonally all the way round it. It has no face.
bouncy.texture: Glossy hot pink rubber with one wide bold deep plum stripe running diagonally all the way round the ball.

pinwheel.prompt: A toy pinwheel standing upright on a short thick white stick about as long as the head is wide: a big pinwheel head of four chunky thick curled blades around a round gold hub at the top. Two blades are tomato red and two are blue, alternating.
pinwheel.texture: Glossy tomato red and blue blades alternating, a shiny gold hub, a bright white stick.

toysoldier.prompt: A chunky painted toy soldier standing stiffly to attention on a small round green base, about twice as tall as it is wide, like a nutcracker figure: a tall black busby hat, a big round peach face with dot eyes, a bright royal blue coat with white cross belts and gold buttons, blue trousers, black boots, arms straight down.
toysoldier.texture: Glossy royal blue coat and trousers, white cross belts, gold buttons, black busby hat and boots, peach face with black dot eyes, a green base.

block.prompt: A classic wooden toy building block painted bright orange: a perfect cube with softly rounded edges. Every face has a raised cream square inside a wide orange border, with one big bold blue star painted in its middle.
block.texture: Glossy bright orange cube; every face has a wide orange border round a raised cream square, each square with one big bold royal blue star in the middle.

blockwall.prompt: A chunky toy wall of four big wooden blocks stacked two on two and fused into one solid square piece, as wide as it is tall and half as deep: tomato red top left, sunny yellow top right, bright orange bottom left, blue bottom right. The orange and yellow blocks each show a cream panel with a blue star.
blockwall.texture: Four solid glossy blocks in tomato red, sunny yellow, bright orange and royal blue with softly rounded edges; a cream square panel with a big blue star on the orange and the yellow block.

rockhorse.prompt: A chunky toddler's rocking horse painted dapple white, about as tall as it is long and a third as wide: a long low body with a red saddle sitting right on two thick curved red rockers, no legs, a tall upright neck rising at the front to a big horse head facing forward, a thick tail and a thick dark mane.
rockhorse.texture: Glossy white horse with big bold grey dapple spots, tomato red saddle and rockers, thick dark brown mane and tail, black dot eyes.

stackrings.prompt: A baby's stacking ring toy: four fat round rings stacked from the biggest at the bottom to the smallest at the top, forming a stepped cone about as tall as its base is wide, with a plain blue cone shaped cap on top. The rings from bottom to top are tomato red, orange, sunny yellow and green.
stackrings.texture: Glossy smooth rings, bottom to top: tomato red, bright orange, sunny yellow, leaf green, and a bright blue cone cap on top. Each part one solid clean colour.

xylo.prompt: A toddler's toy xylophone lying flat: a very low chunky white trapezoid frame about twice as long as it is wide, carrying six thick glossy bars laid across it side by side, graded from long at the wide end to short at the narrow end, each bar a different bold rainbow colour.
xylo.texture: Glossy white frame; six thick plain bars, each one solid bold colour in rainbow order: tomato red, orange, sunny yellow, green, blue, purple.

toyphone.prompt: A child's toy rotary telephone sitting flat: a chunky rounded tomato red box about twice as wide as it is tall with a plain smooth front, a big cream handset lying across the top with its round ends bulging past both sides, and a round white dial with big finger holes on top in front of the handset.
toyphone.texture: Glossy tomato red body, smooth cream handset, a plain white dial with large round finger holes, no numbers or markings.

flowerbed.prompt: A small garden flower bed: a low chunky planter box painted bright blue, about one and a half times as long as it is wide, filled with dark soil, with four big round flower heads in pink, sunny yellow and rose pink resting right on the soil with no stems, and two round green bushes between them.
flowerbed.texture: Bright blue painted planter sides, dark brown soil, chunky round flower heads in bright pink, sunny yellow and rose pink, round leafy green bushes.

dollchair.prompt: An empty doll's chair painted bright pink: a small square seat on four thick round plum legs, a tall flat backrest rising from the back edge, the whole chair about twice as tall as it is wide with the backrest taller than the legs. A big white heart painted on the backrest.
dollchair.texture: Glossy bright pink seat and backrest, deep plum legs, one big white heart painted in the middle of the backrest.

die.prompt: A chunky toy die: a cube with softly rounded corners and edges, painted glossy bright white with big round black dots on every face, like a board game die.
die.texture: Glossy bright white cube with big round jet black dots.

paperplane.prompt: A folded paper plane with two wide pointed wings and a sharp nose, about one and a half times as long as it is wide, made of crisp white paper with one bold red stripe along each wing.
paperplane.texture: Crisp bright white paper with one bold tomato red stripe along each wing.

lego.prompt: A generic toy building brick: a chunky glossy red rectangular block twice as long as it is wide and a little taller than it is wide, with two round studs on top. Plain studs, no letters, no logo.
lego.texture: Glossy tomato red plastic all over, plain studs with nothing printed on them.

puzzlepiece.prompt: A chunky jigsaw puzzle piece lying flat, thick like a wooden toy puzzle piece, about three times as wide as it is thick, with round knobs sticking out on two sides and round notches cut into the other two.
puzzlepiece.texture: Glossy bright blue painted wood, one smooth solid colour.

yoyo.prompt: A classic toy yoyo standing on its edge: two fat round discs joined by a short thick axle in the middle, the discs bright red with a bold white ring painted on each outer face. No string.
yoyo.texture: Glossy bright red discs with a bold white ring on each face, a cream axle.

jack.prompt: A single chunky toy jack from the game of jacks: six short thick arms with round ball ends pointing in six directions from a round centre ball, like a star with knobs.
jack.texture: Shiny polished silver metal with a soft gloss.

lmDovecote.prompt: A grand garden dovecote tower, nearly twice as tall as it is wide: a tall round white tower on a low three step square plinth, rows of small arched pigeon holes all round, a wide low blue cone roof twice as wide as the tower, a gold ball on top, two white doves sitting on the roof edge.
lmDovecote.texture: Moon white tower, cornflower blue pigeon holes, a glazed light cornflower blue tile roof, warm cream stone steps, a shining lantern gold ball, two white doves with dot eyes.

lmGazeboPond.prompt: A copper roofed garden gazebo in its own round pond with a low stone rim, about as tall as the pond is wide: an open ring of chunky white columns on a stepped stone platform in the middle of the water, under a broad straight sided copper cone roof overhanging well past them, a gold ball on top.
lmGazeboPond.texture: Bright copper metal roof, light and warm like a new penny, moon white columns, warm cream stone steps and pond rim, clear sky blue water, a lantern gold ball.

lmArmillary.prompt: A giant armillary sphere sculpture: an open ball of three thick plain gold rings crossing at angles with wide gaps, a small pale blue globe at its centre on a thick tilted rod. The ball is most of its height, far wider than its base, resting low on a short pedestal on a low three step square plinth.
lmArmillary.texture: Plain shining lantern gold rings with no markings, a pale blue globe, a moon white rod, a warm cream stone pedestal with a gold band, warm cream stone steps.

lmGlasshouse.prompt: A grand garden glasshouse pavilion, about as wide as it is tall: a hall of big frosted glass panels on a low stone plinth, ringed by chunky white columns that hold up a huge low four sided pyramid glass roof overhanging on every side, a gold finial on the peak.
lmGlasshouse.texture: Frosted opaque pale mint glass panels in thick moon white frames, moon white columns, a pale mint roof with white ribs, a warm cream stone plinth, a lantern gold finial.

lmMoonBridge.prompt: A moon bridge in its own round pond, wider than the bridge, with a low stone rim: one steep high arch of pale stone shaped like a half circle, twice as long as it is tall, a big round opening under it, a broad walkway a third as wide as it is long, low solid side walls, a stone lantern at each end.
lmMoonBridge.texture: Moon white stone arch, side walls and lanterns, glowing lantern gold lantern lights, clear sky blue pond water, a warm cream stone pond rim.

lmTopiaryStag.prompt: A topiary stag: a smooth rounded clipped hedge shaped like a proud standing stag, dotted with round white blossoms, taller than it is long, deep chest, four sturdy legs, short tail, arched neck holding the head high, no face, huge chunky gold antlers with thick tines, on a low round stone plinth.
lmTopiaryStag.texture: Light mint green clipped hedge dotted all over with round moon white and a few petal pink blossoms, shining lantern gold antlers, a warm cream stone plinth.

pergola.prompt: A garden rose pergola you could walk under, about as tall as it is wide: four thick square white posts holding a flat open frame of just four thick beams, with three big round pink roses with thick rounded petals and a few big rounded leaves resting on the top beams.
pergola.texture: Moon white painted posts and beams, big soft petal pink and deeper rose pink blooms, a few mint green leaves.

scarecrow.prompt: A friendly garden scarecrow with no legs, on one thick wooden pole, about twice as tall as it is wide: arms stretched straight out to the sides on a crossbar, a pale blue patched coat, a round cream sack head with simple dot eyes, a small pointed straw hat, chunky rounded straw tufts at the cuffs.
scarecrow.texture: Pale sky blue coat with one petal pink patch, a warm cream sack head with dot eyes, a lantern gold straw hat and straw tufts, a pale wooden pole.

greenhouse.prompt: A small garden greenhouse, a little longer than it is tall: a glass house of big square frosted panes in thick white frames, a pointed glass roof, a white framed door in the middle of the long side, the panes glowing softly like a lantern.
greenhouse.texture: Frosted opaque pale mint glass panes glowing softly, thick moon white frames and corner posts, a pale blue door.

gardenshed.prompt: A wide boxy wooden garden tool shed painted pale blue, about as tall as it is wide: walls of thick vertical planks, a pointed pink roof that overhangs a little, a plain plank door in the middle of the front, and one square window beside it glowing warm gold.
gardenshed.texture: Pale sky blue painted planks, a moon white door and white corner boards, a petal pink roof, a square window glowing lantern gold.

dovecote.prompt: A small garden dovecote, a little tower home for doves: a stout eight sided white tower nearly twice as tall as wide, a short pointed eight sided roof of gold shingles overhanging a little, two arched holes with perch ledges, one high on the front, one lower on the side, a white dove on a ledge.
dovecote.texture: Chalky moon white walls, a lantern gold shingle roof, cornflower blue entrance holes, white perch ledges, a white dove with dot eyes.

firefly.prompt: A cartoon firefly flying level, side on, head at the front: a small round pale blue head with dot eyes and two short thick antennae, and a bigger round tail behind it in line, smooth and glowing bright lemon yellow with no stripes. Two small thick wings just behind the head, the tail bare on top.
firefly.texture: Pale sky blue head and small wings, black dot eyes, cream antennae, a big smooth tail glowing bright lemon yellow all over with no stripes.

hedgehog.prompt: A cartoon hedgehog, a real animal on all fours, walking low and level, side on, nose at the front: a plump ball shaped body a little longer than it is tall, a pointed cream snout, and a back covered in short thick soft rounded spikes, pale cream tipped in soft gold. Dot eyes, a small dark nose.
hedgehog.texture: Pale cream spikes with soft lantern gold tips, a warm cream face, snout and belly, a small dark brown nose, black dot eyes, petal pink feet.

toadG.prompt: A cartoon garden toad, a real wild animal sitting low and squat, side on, head at the front: a big round light leaf green body a little wider than it is tall, a smaller round head set high in front with two big round golden eye bumps on top, its back legs folded at its sides, a few soft warts.
toadG.texture: Light leaf green back with a few paler round warts, a warm cream belly and throat, golden yellow eye bumps with black dot pupils.

snailG.prompt: A cartoon garden snail crawling low and level, side on, head at the front: a big round lantern gold spiral shell almost as tall as the snail is long, on a long low soft cream body sticking out in front, two short thick eye stalks with dot eyes on its head. The spiral shows on both sides.
snailG.texture: Glossy lantern gold shell with a bold cream spiral stripe on each side, a pale warm cream body, black dot eyes on the stalk tips.

kFireflyJar.prompt: A firefly jar: a chunky round glass jar about as wide as it is tall, straight sided, with a wide lantern gold screw lid. The glass is opaque frosted pale mint that glows softly, with five soft round bright lemon yellow firefly lights glowing through its sides.
kFireflyJar.texture: Opaque frosted pale mint glass glowing softly, five round bright lemon yellow firefly glows with soft pale halos on its sides, a shiny lantern gold lid.

kTrowel.prompt: A garden hand trowel lying on its back, about twice as long as its blade is wide: a plain wide pointed scoop blade of polished silver metal, thick with soft rounded edges, joined by a short thick bent gold neck to a thick round handle painted pale mint, about as long as the blade.
kTrowel.texture: Plain polished pale silver steel scoop blade with no markings, a short shiny lantern gold neck, a thick handle painted pale mint with a cream end cap.

kOrchid.prompt: A white orchid in chunky glazed ceramic, a third taller than it is wide: a thick upright stem with two broad thick round leaves at its foot, topped by one big moon white flower facing forward, two wide thick round side petals, one round top petal and a small cupped gold lip. No pot, no face.
kOrchid.texture: Glossy moon white petals with a faint lavender blush near the centre, a lantern gold lip, a pale mint green stem and leaves.

kGroveKey.prompt: A chunky plain old fashioned key of polished gold metal lying flat, about two and a half times as long as its bow is wide: a thick round ring bow at one end, a thick round shaft, and a chunky square bit with two square teeth at the other end. One small round mint gem where the bow meets the shaft.
kGroveKey.texture: Bright plain polished lantern gold metal all over, one small glossy pale mint gem.

kWhistle.prompt: A round clay whistle like a small ocarina, a third wider than it is tall: a smooth pale apricot glazed ball with a short thick flattened mouthpiece sticking out from one side angled up, its tip level with the top of the ball, a small square sound hole beside it and three round finger holes on top.
kWhistle.texture: Pale apricot glaze all over, the mouthpiece too, the sound hole and finger holes a deeper warm apricot.

gnome.prompt: A classic glazed pottery garden gnome standing upright, about twice as tall as he is wide: a pale blue coat flaring wide at the bottom, a round face, round nose and dot eyes, a big fluffy white beard down his chest, a tall stiff pointed red hat nearly as tall as his body. A gold belt. No props.
gnome.texture: Bright coral red hat, moon white beard, warm peach face and nose with black dot eyes, pale sky blue coat, lantern gold belt, warm cream boots.

pumpkin.prompt: A big plump orange garden pumpkin, a little wider than it is tall and slightly lumpy with soft bulges, deep rounded ribs running from top to bottom, its skin bright light orange all over, with a short thick slightly bent stalk on top. A plain whole pumpkin: no face, no carving, no leaves, no vine.
pumpkin.texture: Bright light tangerine orange skin, the ribs a touch paler golden orange, a pale mint green stalk.

benchG.prompt: A wooden garden bench painted pale sky blue, about one and a half times as wide as it is tall: a long thick plank seat at knee height, a tall solid backrest board rising from its back edge, as tall as the legs and leaning back a little, and one thick solid slab leg set in from each end. No arms.
benchG.texture: Pale sky blue paint on the seat and backrest with soft lighter lines between the planks, moon white slab legs.

lantern.prompt: A round paper lantern standing upright, its fat body about as tall as it is wide: plain lantern gold paper, a little fuller in the middle, with soft ribbed pleats all round, a thick petal pink rim at the top and the bottom, and a short thick arched handle on top. No tassel, no face.
lantern.texture: Warm glowing lantern gold paper with soft lighter rib lines, plain with no writing or pictures, thick petal pink rims and handle.

moonflower.prompt: A chunky cartoon moonflower, a little taller than it is wide: one big open bloom of five thick rounded moon white petals, soft like clay, around a round gold centre, tilted up to the sky, on a thick mint stem as tall as the bloom is wide, rising from two big thick rounded mint leaves. No face.
moonflower.texture: Moon white petals, a lantern gold centre, a soft mint stem and leaves, each part one clean colour.

moonstone.prompt: A big moonstone boulder, about as tall as it is wide: one rounded stone polished smooth like a giant tumbled gem, with a few broad soft facets, milky pale blue with a moon white sheen, and one smaller matching stone half its size nestled against its front at the base. No stand, no face.
moonstone.texture: Milky pale blue stone with soft swirls of moon white sheen, the smaller stone a lighter pale blue.

wheelbarrow.prompt: A garden wheelbarrow, about twice as long as it is tall: a deep empty open tub painted petal pink, one single big fat wheel at the front with a thick moon white tyre, and two thick straight cream handles reaching back behind the tub, with two short sturdy legs under it.
wheelbarrow.texture: Petal pink painted tub with a rolled rim, a moon white tyre round a lantern gold hub, warm cream handles and legs.

trellisG.prompt: A white garden trellis arch, about one and a half times as tall as it is wide and shallow front to back: two tall narrow posts of thick criss cross lattice bars, joined on top by a thick round arch, with four big round petal pink roses and a few big thick mint leaves climbing it.
trellisG.texture: Moon white painted wood, petal pink roses, soft mint leaves, each part one clean colour.

topiaryball.prompt: A clipped garden topiary, nearly twice as tall as it is wide: a big smooth round ball with a smaller ball two thirds its size sitting on top, both light mint green and smooth like felt, painted with tiny white flowers, on a short thick trunk a quarter of its height. No pot, no face.
topiaryball.texture: Light mint green with a soft painted pattern of tiny leaves, tiny moon white flowers dotted all over, a warm cream trunk.

stonelantern.prompt: A pale moonlit Japanese stone lantern, about twice as tall as it is wide: a square post half as wide as the roof, a wide square ledge, a small square light box with big glowing gold paper windows on all four sides, and a wide square pyramid roof with straight edges and a round knob on top.
stonelantern.texture: Pale moonlit stone in moon white with a faint blue tint, glowing lantern gold window panels on all four sides, plain smooth stone with no carving.

compostheap.prompt: A garden compost heap: one low lumpy mound of earth, about one and a half times as wide as it is tall, made of three big rounded lumps fused together, with a big yellow banana peel, its thick flaps splayed open, and a chunky apple core lying on top. No face.
compostheap.texture: Warm light cocoa brown crumbly soil streaked with pale gold straw, a bright lantern gold banana peel, a cream apple core with petal pink skin.

sundial.prompt: An old garden sundial of pale moonlit stone, a little taller than it is wide: a stout round pillar wider at its foot, a solid flat round dial plate twice as wide as the pillar, and one big thick gold triangle pointer standing up across the dial like a fin. Plain hour dots, no numerals, no face.
sundial.texture: Pale moonlit stone in moon white, the dial face ringed with round lantern gold hour dots, a lantern gold pointer, no numerals, no face, a little mint moss at the foot.

beehive.prompt: A traditional straw bee skep, as tall as it is wide: a tall rounded beehive dome of thick coiled straw rings stacked from widest at the bottom to a small rounded top, with one small dark arched doorway at the bottom front and a thick drip of golden honey oozing out of it. No face.
beehive.texture: Pale straw gold coils with soft lighter binding lines, a glossy lantern gold honey drip, a deep brown doorway.

rake.prompt: A garden leaf rake lying flat on the ground, about three times as long as it is wide: a long chunky round wooden handle, and at one end a wide flat triangular fan of seven thick rounded tines spreading out from the handle tip, joined by one thick curved crossbar, the fan a third of the length.
rake.texture: Warm cream painted wooden handle, a bright lantern gold fan head and tines, a pale sky blue band where the head meets the handle.

slab.prompt: A garden stepping stone lying flat on the ground: one thick flagstone of pale matte stone about six times as wide as it is thick, almost as deep as it is wide, with softly rounded corners, uneven bevelled edges, a gently domed worn top and one small round cushion of moss at one edge.
slab.texture: Pale moonlit stone in moon white with a soft blue grey tint, a lighter worn top, a faint fine speckle, slightly greyer edges, one small mint green moss cushion.

fernG.prompt: A chunky glazed ceramic fern with no pot, a little taller than it is wide: three big thick fronds arching up and out from one sturdy base, each a long tapering leaf with soft rounded scallops on both edges, the tallest nearly upright, its tip curled into a fat tight spiral fiddlehead on top.
fernG.texture: Pale luminous mint green fronds with moon white middle veins, the coiled fiddlehead a soft lantern gold.

birdbath.prompt: A classic stone garden bird bath, a little wider than it is tall: a wide shallow round basin full of still water on a thick sturdy pedestal that flares out to a round foot, the basin three times as wide as the pedestal, and one small plump bird statue perched on its rim.
birdbath.texture: Pale moonlit stone in moon white with a soft blue grey tint, luminous pale sky blue water filling the basin, a lantern gold bird with small dot eyes.

hedgewall.prompt: One section of a clipped garden hedge as one solid chunky block, about as tall as it is wide and half as deep: sides that bulge gently and round over into a soft top peaking in the middle, every face shaped as big smooth rounded lumps of clipped leaves, straight upright ends.
hedgewall.texture: Light luminous mint green leaf clumps dotted all over with small moon white blossoms and a few petal pink ones.

stonewall.prompt: One section of an old dry stone wall as one solid chunky block, a little wider than it is tall, less than half as deep and slightly narrower at the top: big blocky stones with soft rounded edges fitted snugly in three rows on its faces, a long flat capstone on top, flat ends, one small moss patch.
stonewall.texture: Pale moonlit stones in moon white and soft pale blue grey, each stone a slightly different pale tint, thin soft grey lines between them, a pale capstone, one small mint moss patch.

dewdrop.prompt: A single plump dew drop of water with no face, about as wide as it is tall: a smooth round droplet sitting on its round bottom and rising to a short soft point at the top, glossy like glass, with nothing inside it.
dewdrop.texture: Luminous pale aqua water in soft mint blue all over, a little paler toward the tip.

mushroom.prompt: A single plump mushroom with no face, a little taller than it is wide: a big round cap that curves down almost into a ball, sitting low on a short thick stem that shows only a little underneath, the whole cap dotted with many small round spots.
mushroom.texture: Luminous soft rose pink cap dotted all over with many small round moon white spots, a warm cream stem and a pale cream underside.

pebble.prompt: A single smooth river pebble: a plump rounded stone nearly as tall as it is wide, gently lumpy and uneven, worn smooth by the river, with one clean band of white quartz wrapped all the way round it.
pebble.texture: Pale warm dove grey stone with a soft fine speckle, one clean moon white quartz band wrapped all the way round it.

tulip.prompt: A single chunky glazed ceramic tulip with no pot, about twice as tall as it is wide: a fat egg shaped cup bloom of thick rounded petals closing to soft points at the top, on one thick sturdy stem about as tall as the bloom, with two big thick rounded leaves curling up from its foot.
tulip.texture: Luminous orchid pink petals, a little paler at the tips, a soft mint green stem and two mint green leaves.

wateringcan.prompt: A classic garden watering can, nearly twice as long as it is tall: a fat round drum body, a long thick spout rising at a slant from halfway up the front to a big round sprinkler head level with the top, and a big thick loop handle on the back.
wateringcan.texture: Pale aqua blue enamel body, spout and handle, a lantern gold sprinkler head at the spout tip, a thin moon white band round the top rim.

flowerpot.prompt: A classic terracotta flower pot, a little taller than it is wide: a round pot tapering toward its base with a thick rolled rim, and one plump round bush of big rounded leaves sitting in it like a ball, two thirds as wide as the rim, rising above it by half the pot height.
flowerpot.texture: Light warm peach terracotta pot and rim, a mint green bush of big rounded geranium leaves with a few round clusters of petal pink flowers.

lmClockTower.prompt: A tall square market clock tower, more than three times as tall as it is wide: a wide four step stone base, a square terracotta tower in three storeys that narrow a little as they rise, each storey with rows of small arched windows glowing warm yellow, a round gold band, then a square clock storey with a round clock face on every side showing plain hour dots and two hands, a ring of slim gold posts above it, and a teal tiled pyramid roof with a tall gold spike and ball.
lmClockTower.texture: Warm terracotta walls with deeper terracotta edges, sandy cream stone steps, warm yellow glowing windows, cream clock faces with dark hands and gold hour dots and no numerals, shining saffron gold band, posts, spike and ball, a teal tiled roof.

lmNoria.prompt: A great wooden water wheel beside a little arched aqueduct, a little wider than it is tall: a huge upright teal wheel with sixteen thick paddles round its rim and gold spokes to a gold hub on a thick dark timber axle, its bottom dipping into a low stone water channel with cream stone walls on each side, and on one side a short terracotta aqueduct on two arches carrying a teal water trough to the top of the wheel.
lmNoria.texture: Deep teal wheel and paddles, shining saffron gold spokes and hub, a dark brown timber axle, cream stone channel walls, clear blue water, terracotta aqueduct arches with a teal trough.

lmCaravanGate.prompt: A grand caravan gate of sun baked stone, about as tall as it is wide and shallow front to back: two thick square towers joined high up by a wide lintel block, a tall archway between them closed by a big plain wooden door, rows of small arched windows in deep blue on the towers, a round drum and a slim pointed spire on top of each tower, a teal tile square on each tower face, and a thin brass rail along the top.
lmCaravanGate.texture: Warm sand stone towers and lintel, a darker sandstone top band, a dark wooden door, deep blue window arches, teal tiles, saffron gold spire tips.

lmSilkPavilion.prompt: A huge round silk pavilion tent, about one and a half times as wide as it is tall: three stacked cone roofs, the lowest the widest, striped in deep blue and saffron gold, on a ring of ten slim deep blue posts with gold caps over a round cream platform, a tall gold mast and ball on the peak, a wide gold doorway panel at the front, and a guy rope pegged out to the ground on each side.
lmSilkPavilion.texture: Deep royal blue and saffron gold cloth cones, deep blue posts with gold caps, a cream stone platform, a saffron gold doorway with a cream curtain, sandy guy ropes, dark wooden pegs, a gold ball on top.

lmSpiceHall.prompt: A spice exchange hall, a little taller than it is wide: a three step stone base, an open arcade of five round arches across the front, a long wall above it with a band of six small windows glowing warm yellow, a flat ledge, a row of five slim columns, and on top one big teal cone dome with a gold ball.
lmSpiceHall.texture: Sandy cream stone arches and walls, a warmer sand top ledge, cream columns, warm yellow glowing windows, a glossy teal dome, a saffron gold ball.

lmBathHouse.prompt: A bath house with turquoise domes, a little wider than it is tall: a low cream stone hall on four wide steps, an arcade of five round arches on the front with warm glowing windows behind, a flat turquoise roof carrying one big round dome and three small ones, each with a gold finial, and a slim round cream tower with a pointed turquoise cap at each back corner.
lmBathHouse.texture: Pale cream stone walls and arches, warm yellow glowing windows, glossy turquoise roof, domes and tower caps, saffron gold finials, sandy stone steps.

camel.prompt: A cartoon camel, a real animal standing on four long legs, side on, head at the front: a long body with one big rounded hump on top, a long neck curving up and forward to a small round head with dot eyes, knobbly knees, a short tail, and a small woven saddle blanket over the hump.
camel.texture: Warm sandy tan fur, a darker tan hump top and knees, a teal and pomegranate red striped saddle blanket, black dot eyes.

dogB.prompt: A cartoon street dog, a real animal trotting on four legs, side on, head at the front: a lean body, a round head with a short muzzle and floppy ears, dot eyes, and a tail curling up behind.
dogB.texture: Warm caramel brown fur, a lighter cream muzzle and chest, darker brown ears, a teal collar, black dot eyes and nose.

catB.prompt: A cartoon market cat, a real animal walking on four legs, side on, head at the front: a slim body, a round head with two pointed ears, dot eyes, and a long tail curving up at the end.
catB.texture: Bright marmalade orange fur with soft paler stripes, a cream chest and paws, a small deep blue collar, black dot eyes.

chicken.prompt: A cartoon hen, a real bird standing, side on, head at the front: a plump round body, a small round head with a short pointed beak, a red comb on top and a red wattle, dot eyes, two short legs, a short fan tail.
chicken.texture: Cream white feathers, a saffron orange beak and legs, a bright red comb and wattle, black dot eyes.

kOilLamp.prompt: A brass oil lamp lying on its base, about one and a half times as long as it is tall: a round squat body, a long tapering spout at the front with a small glowing flame at its tip, a curled loop handle at the back, and a small domed lid.
kOilLamp.texture: Polished saffron gold brass with darker gold edges, a soft glowing pale yellow flame.

kFigJar.prompt: A honeyed fig jar, about as wide as it is tall: a round glazed pottery jar with a wide rim and a round wooden lid, one plump purple fig painted on its front.
kFigJar.texture: Golden honey glazed jar, a warm brown wooden lid, a plum purple fig with a mint green leaf.

kBirdcage.prompt: A small round songbird cage, a little taller than it is wide: a round gold base, a round dome of thin gold bars, a gold ring on top to hang it by, and one little round blue songbird sitting inside on a perch.
kBirdcage.texture: Shining saffron gold bars, base and ring, a sky blue songbird with dot eyes.

kSlipper.prompt: A single fancy curled toe slipper lying on its side, about three times as long as it is tall: a low slipper with a long toe that curls up into a point, a little gold pompom on the tip, and a raised heel.
kSlipper.texture: Deep plum pink velvet with a lighter rose pink heel, a saffron gold pompom and gold trim along the edge.

kScroll.prompt: A rolled star map scroll lying flat, about five times as long as it is thick: a fat cream paper roll on a dark wooden rod that sticks out at both ends, finished with a gold knob on each end, a few tiny gold stars dotted on the paper.
kScroll.texture: Cream paper, a dark brown wooden rod, saffron gold end knobs, tiny gold stars.

stall.prompt: A market awning stall, a little wider than it is tall: a long wooden counter on four thin posts, the back posts taller, holding a sloping striped cloth awning that tips down toward the front with a scalloped edge.
stall.texture: Warm brown wooden counter and posts, an awning striped in pomegranate red and cream with a teal scalloped trim.

minaret.prompt: A tall slender round tower, more than four times as tall as it is wide: a smooth round cream shaft slightly wider at its foot, a round gold balcony ring near the top, a short narrower round top storey with one small arched window glowing warm yellow, a round teal onion dome, and a slim gold spike on top. No symbols.
minaret.texture: Cream white plaster tower, a saffron gold balcony ring and spike, a glossy teal dome, a warm yellow glowing window.

barrel.prompt: A wooden cellar barrel standing upright, a little taller than it is wide: a bulging round barrel of wooden staves with three dark metal hoops round it.
barrel.texture: Warm brown wooden staves with soft lighter lines between them, dark grey metal hoops.

cartB.prompt: A wooden fruit cart, about twice as long as it is tall: a flat wooden bed on two big wooden wheels, a long handle sticking out at the front, and a heap of round fruit on top, oranges, red apples, lemons and green limes.
cartB.texture: Warm brown wooden bed, darker brown wheels, bright orange, red, yellow and lime green fruit.

streetlamp.prompt: A tall old iron street lamp, about four times as tall as it is wide: a round base, a tall thin tapering post, and at the top a curved arm reaching out to one side holding a round glowing lamp globe.
streetlamp.texture: Dark charcoal iron post, arm and base, a soft glowing warm yellow globe.

teahouse.prompt: A little tea house, a little wider than it is tall: a square cream plaster building, a wooden door at the front, two square windows glowing warm yellow, a pomegranate red cloth awning over the front, and a low pyramid roof of terracotta tiles.
teahouse.texture: Cream plaster walls, a dark wooden door, warm yellow glowing windows, a pomegranate red awning, terracotta tile roof.

carpetstack.prompt: A stack of four folded carpets lying flat, about twice as wide as it is tall: four thick folded rugs piled up, each one a little skewed, each a different colour with a simple border.
carpetstack.texture: From the bottom: pomegranate red, deep blue, saffron gold and leaf green carpets, each with a cream border.

doorarch.prompt: A blue door in a stone arch, about one and a half times as tall as it is wide and shallow front to back: two thick square stone posts and a stone lintel framing a tall deep blue wooden door with a round gold knob.
doorarch.texture: Cream plaster stone frame, a deep cobalt blue door, a shining gold knob.

waterwell.prompt: An old stone well, about as tall as it is wide: a round low wall of stone, two wooden posts rising from its sides holding a crossbar with a wooden winding roller, and a little wooden bucket hanging in the middle.
waterwell.texture: Grey stone wall with soft lighter stones, warm brown wooden posts, crossbar and bucket.

rugroll.prompt: A rolled up rug lying on its side, about three times as long as it is thick: a fat rolled carpet showing its spiral end, a cream fringe at the ends.

fountain.prompt: A tiled courtyard fountain, about twice as wide as it is tall: a wide round low basin full of water, a short thick column in the middle holding a smaller round bowl, and a small round spout on top.
fountain.texture: Pale blue grey stone with a band of teal and deep blue tiles round the basin, light clear blue water.

spicepyramid.prompt: A spice pyramid on a round tray, a little wider than it is tall: a tall pointed cone of heaped spice powder on a flat round tray, with one small red cone of a second spice beside it.
spicepyramid.texture: Bright saffron orange spice cone, a smaller pomegranate red spice cone, a warm brown wooden tray.

basketB.prompt: A woven market basket, about as tall as it is wide: a round basket wider at the top with a thick woven rim, heaped with three round fruits, an orange, a red apple and a lemon.
basketB.texture: Warm straw gold woven basket with a darker woven rim, bright orange, red and yellow fruit.

stool.prompt: A small wooden market stool, about as tall as it is wide: a round wooden seat on four slightly splayed legs.
stool.texture: Warm brown wooden seat and legs.

bicycle.prompt: An old fashioned bicycle standing upright, side on, about one and a half times as long as it is tall: two big thin spoked wheels, a simple frame, a saddle and curved handlebars.
bicycle.texture: Pomegranate red frame, black tyres, cream spokes, a brown leather saddle, dark handlebars.

brickwall.prompt: One section of a mudbrick wall as one solid chunky block, about as tall as it is wide and a third as deep: smooth sun baked mudbrick with a flat top ledge and three square bricks standing up on top like little battlements, a few brick shapes showing on its faces.
brickwall.texture: Warm sand mudbrick, a darker sand top ledge and battlements, a few faint terracotta bricks.

cratewall.prompt: A stack of three wooden freight crates as one solid chunky block, a little wider than it is tall: two crates side by side on the ground and one on top, each slightly turned, each with a dark wooden band round it.
cratewall.texture: Warm brown and lighter brown wooden crates, dark brown wooden bands.

crate.prompt: An open wooden fruit crate, a little wider than it is tall: a slatted box of wooden boards, open on top, full of round oranges.
crate.texture: Warm brown wooden slats, bright orange fruit.

riad.prompt: A town house with a roof terrace, about as tall as it is wide: a big square sand coloured house with a flat roof and a top ledge, a smaller square room on one side of the roof, a wooden door at the front, and two tall windows with deep blue shutters.
riad.texture: Warm sand plaster walls, a darker sand ledge, a dark wooden door, deep blue shutters.

grainsack.prompt: A plump grain sack standing up, a little taller than it is wide: a round bulging burlap sack, wider at the bottom, gathered at the top into a tied neck.
grainsack.texture: Pale oatmeal burlap with soft darker weave lines, a brown string tie.

brasslamp.prompt: A small brass lantern lamp, about as tall as it is wide: a round brass body on a small round foot, a pointed brass cap on top, and a short spout at one side, glowing softly.
brasslamp.texture: Polished saffron gold brass, a soft warm yellow glow.

spicesack.prompt: A small spice sack, about as tall as it is wide: a round soft sack with its top rolled down, showing a heap of bright red spice inside.
spicesack.texture: Sandy tan cloth sack, bright pomegranate red spice.

scooter.prompt: A child's push scooter standing upright, side on, a little longer than it is tall: a long low deck on two small black wheels, a tall slightly tilted steering post at the front with a T handlebar.
scooter.texture: Bright sky blue deck and post, black wheels and handle grips.

jug.prompt: A small clay water jug, a little taller than it is wide: a round belly, a short narrow neck with a lip, and a curved loop handle on one side.
jug.texture: Warm terracotta clay with a slightly darker handle.

tajine.prompt: A tajine cooking pot, about as tall as it is wide: a wide shallow round base dish and a tall pointed cone lid with a little round gold knob on top.
tajine.texture: Terracotta base dish, a glossy pomegranate red cone lid, a saffron gold knob.

potterystack.prompt: A stack of three pots, a little taller than it is wide: a wide bowl at the bottom, a smaller bowl on it, and a round jar with a short neck on top.
potterystack.texture: Warm terracotta pots, each a slightly different shade, one with a thin teal glaze band.

hookah.prompt: A tall brass ewer pitcher, a little taller than it is wide: a round glass belly at the bottom, a tall slim gold neck, a small flared brass cup on top, and one curved loop handle from the neck to the belly.
hookah.texture: Violet glass belly, shining saffron gold neck and handle, a warm copper cup.

bread.prompt: A long bread loaf lying flat, about twice as long as it is tall: three plump round puffs of crust joined in a row.
bread.texture: Golden baked crust, a little browner on top.

copperpot.prompt: A wide copper cooking pot, about twice as wide as it is tall: a round pot slightly wider at the top, with a small loop handle on each side.
copperpot.texture: Shiny warm copper with darker copper handles.

melonstack.prompt: A little pyramid of four melons, about as tall as it is wide: three round melons in a ring on the ground and one on top.
melonstack.texture: Deep green melons with paler green stripes.

pome.prompt: A single pomegranate, a little taller than it is wide: a round fruit with a small crown of short points on top.
pome.texture: Deep pomegranate red skin, a darker red crown.

lemon.prompt: A single lemon lying on its side, a little longer than it is tall: an oval fruit with a small point at one end.
lemon.texture: Bright lemon yellow with a slightly darker tip.

A single object on its own, centred. No text, no logos, no face, no ground, no extra display base, no background.
toyshop.textureStyle: Flat bright painted colours, soft and clean, no shadows or highlights painted in, no text, no logos.

miniature.style: A handmade miniature for a cosy cartoon game: a rounded, tactile object with broad soft colour areas and a gentle hint of its real material, so food looks like food, porcelain like glaze, cloth like cloth, wood like wood. One clear main shape, one recognisable feature, at most two small accents. Warm, bright, appetising colours. A single object on its own, centred. No text, no logos, no face, no ground, no extra display base, no background.
miniature.textureStyle: Broad soft colour areas with a gentle material hint, clean and warm, no shadows or highlights painted in, no text, no logos.

toybox.style: A toy for a bright cartoon game, Toybox Peaks look: chunky rounded forms, soft bevelled edges, glossy painted wood and smooth plastic, bold saturated colours in crisp clean areas. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no ground, no extra display base, no background.

lantern.style: A garden thing for a cosy cartoon game at night, Night Garden look: chunky rounded forms, soft bevelled edges, pale glazed pottery, painted wood and soft petals in light luminous colours, moon white, lantern gold, petal pink, pale blue and mint, so it glows against dark grass. One clear main shape, one recognisable feature, at most two small accents. A creature that has a face keeps simple dot eyes. A single object on its own, centred. No text, no logos, no ground, no background.
lantern.textureStyle: Light luminous painted colours with a soft glaze, crisp clean colour areas, nothing dark or muddy, no shadows or highlights painted in, no text, no logos.

bazaar.style: A market thing for a sunny cartoon game, Bazaar Lane look: chunky rounded forms, soft bevelled edges, painted wood, glazed tiles, hammered brass and woven cloth in clear bright colours, warm cream, saffron gold and terracotta with strong teal, deep blue and pomegranate red, so it stands out on sandy ground. One clear main shape, one recognisable feature, at most two small accents. A creature that has a face keeps simple dot eyes. A single object on its own, centred. No text, no logos, no ground, no background.
bazaar.textureStyle: Clear bright painted colours with a soft glaze, crisp clean colour areas, nothing dark or muddy, no shadows or highlights painted in, no text, no logos.
bazaar.note: w4 Bazaar Lane, 10 Oct (Opus, under his ruling that every world goes the Astra way): the game's own colour law for this world (index.html, the COLOUR PER WORLD note) is that it is warm sand and terracotta already, so TEAL and DEEP BLUE are the saturated hues it does not own; another orange thing files itself under the riad.
